name: Brownside
description:
'''Brownside''' is an American hip-hop group from [[South Los Angeles|South Central Los Angeles]] organized by American rapper [[Eazy-E]]. The original members of the group consisted of Toker, Fello, Wicked and Danger, with Trouble and Klever joining the group later on. Klever is the also the baby brother of Toker. Originally, [[Eazy-E]] had signed Brownside to [[Ruthless Records]] in hope to create a [[Chicano rap]] version of his former group [[N.W.A]].

Toker described the group as "gangsters trying to be rappers, rather than rappers trying to be gangsters."

Three members of the group have died: Fello, Toker and Danger.
